description: Nightning's magnum opus, serving as a collection of his thoughts and feelings during his creation process and taking inspiration from the "Blurryface" album by twenty one pilots. The decoration is entirely red, black and white, and the level builds up to a near-incomprehensible yet incredibly cathartic wave section at the song's climax. The only extreme to have its own ARG.

name: Celestial Force
description: A mid 2018 megacollab that mainly focuses on asymmetrical duals. The gameplay is incredibly learny and fast paced with the duals requiring complex timings and learning.

name: Freedom08
description: An intense four-minute megacollab featuring some very iconic names from early 2.1. It uses its iconic song to the maximum with very high-speed gameplay through the whole level. Its the first extreme to use Freedom Dive as a song, and has been remade in multiple different updates of the game.

name: Nunri
description: Szilu's hardest solo level, a purple design level which is well balanced and uses most gamemodes.

name: Loochiverse
description: Made for the MatMart Civilization event with a bossfight against one of the creators (EpicLooch) made through image2gd, although he can't actually damage you. Got a nerfdate later on to make it more timing based and to fix the balancing issues while still keeping it predrop heavy.

name: Atmos
description: A second-half heavy Marwec level decorated by a multitude of art-style creators that went through several balancing updates. Features a randomized path at 35% before ramping up in difficulty for the rest of the level with mainly wave-focused asymmetrical duals and chokepoints.

name: Erebus (BoldStep)
description: Member of the RGB, themed around radioactivity. While it's shorter in length than the other two levels of the trilogy, it makes up for it by having some of the most difficult raw gameplay for its time. Its gameplay is very skill-based with many difficult ship and wave sections sprinkled throughout such as the iconic 85% slope corridor, alongside a distinctive memory cube maze right before the drop.

name: Echoes of Neon
description: A remake of Forsaken Neon and MinAY's proudest megacollab project. It has the original level's colour scheme, slope-oriented structures, large orb clusters and speed portals, while overhauling the decoration with modern tech-based designs and an extension which nearly doubles its length.

name: Dark Flare
description: The final and hardest level by Lightning Collab Team, this megacollaboration has no defined decorative theme. It is best known for the part by Dotory that was significantly buffed by the verifier, Plusxenon.

name: Luminosity
description: Atmospheric light themed extreme creatively using pads, portals & jump-rings as decoration. Contains difficult swing sections and flowy orb-based gameplay with bright particle-based backgrounds.

name: Chromatic Haze
description: The official sequel to Prismatic Haze, containing even more hard waves, fast-paced and tightier gameplay, clicksync and an even longer and more nerve-racking ending than it's prequel. It also features a very scary-looking last ship containing a black orb as the last click followed by a kinda tight gap as the final release. Despite all of that, it's generally just as well received as Prismatic Haze.

name: The Mainframe
description: Notoriously learny memory level filled with creative gimmicks and gameplay tropes. Initially was inspired by the Ultimate Chicken Horse level of the same name.

name: Timor
description: A horror-themed level with gameplay by Colorbolt and decoration by Maxie25. It started as a top 1 layout which was later nerfed to a top 30 during its verification process. The gameplay is very brief and wave-focused.

name: Tapwreck
description: A claustrophobic timings-focused level with corridor gameplay, UFO spam, an infamous first wave with fixed hitboxes and an ending cube with near-blind timings.

name: Ascension
description: A four minute long rainbow level to the tune of Abracadavre from Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies. A passion project seven years in the making with detailed rainbow designs, interesting line art, and hard gameplay throughout. One of the rawest extremes in the game.

name: Glory
description: A Christian megacollab hosted by Entique, intended to remind everyone of God's love and glory. The level itself is a purple glow-flow with an upbeat Colbreakz song.

name: Jamboree
description: Extremon which takes heavy inspiration from Spectrum Cyclone. Like its predecessor, it features learny asymmetrical dual gameplay and a very hard wave at the end.

name: Ddiamond
description: Colourful wave-based demon featuring Lfritz' trademark rainbow decoration and tight wave corridor gameplay similar to Diamond Blade, as well as some timings and ship gameplay.

name: Devil Vortex
description: A level that came from a denied part for Yatagarasu, which Rustam expanded on to make a full level. The decoration uses a hell theme with recognizable artworks. ToshDeluxe superbuffed and hack-verified the level, which later became one of the most infamous hacker exposals.

name: Dole Damos
description: Quirky Jeyzor level known for its unique designs and fancy transitions. The gameplay is entirely made of duals besides one transition.

name: Factory Realm X
description: Very old 2.1 grayscale level featuring learny duals, a chokeable last swingcopter and a bossfight (with some inconsistent layering). Generally well-received despite its age.

name: DubKore X
description: A faithful remake of DubCore by MaJackO and Crack, which is one of the hardest 8* levels. This level follows the conventions of MaJackO’s “Core” series, featuring 1.9-style decoration and primarily slow paced gameplay.

name: Next Stage
description: Zipixbox and TMco collab that is the successor to Heavens Door. Inspired by the Stage 4 boss from I Wanna Kill The Kamilia 3, and a 2.0 level of the same name. Features flashbacks to various older levels in reference to the IWKTK3 bossfight, as well as fully randomized bullet hell styled parts.

name: ConFusion
description: The second and easiest level of the ConTrilogy. Despite not being as fast as the original, this fusion laboratory still contains a hectic amount of movements. With the amount of flashing pulses and fakes featured, your learning experience may be too confusing to handle.

name: Retention Rush
description: Very purple memory extreme that mostly consists of fake structures, orbs and portals. The ending requires hitting certain coins after the "listen closely" text. Otherwise, you get geometrically dominated.

name: Tenochtitlan
description: Acropolis-styled level with a theme centered around the ancient Aztec city of the same name. It's very timing based, featuring a lot of hard cube and ball parts, as well as a kind of chokeable wave at the end. Rumoured to not be well placed due to lack of victors.

name: FIREPOWER (Sillow)
description: One of the longest nine circles extremes with a highly diverse skillset range. Has a high quality orange design style with a lot of character, featuring many creatures and monsters, and even has a snake that you fly through. Gets gradually harder and faster paced as the level progresses, and features hard asymmetrical duals.

name: 0 Techno
description: Cherryteam collab hosted by MinAY, 'designed to make your eyes bleed'. Verification video is a placeholder showcase

name: lacy
description: Calm pink XL megacollab to the tune of Lacy by Olivia Rodrigo. Has an asymmetrical dual in the middle where your icon can land on your ship.

name: bell
description: Solo extreme with faithful, highly detailed core-styled decoration.

name: POW
description: Super spammy level that is the sequel to WOW

name: Death
description: A nine minute long emotionally powerful level that took over six years to complete. The first third is noticeably harder, but there is still tough gameplay very far into the level. A tribute to TSGuy, may he rest in peace.

name: Apollo 11
description: The finale to Nasgubb's Space Trilogy that took over two years to create. A very long moon themed extreme with mostly simple consistency based gameplay, though it does feature a few memory/gimmicky sections. Known for being very stressful but enjoyable.

name: TheCinnyBun
description: A joke level Renn241 created for the player Cinny. The gameplay is made up of super fast flow gameplay and extremely difficult wave sections.

name: Digital Descent
description: A former Top 1 which was originally easier than its predecessor until it got a buffdate. The decoration follows a similar theme to Artifical Ascent with 2.1 elements sprinkled throughout, and its difficulty notably spikes in the middle third of the level.

name: Stalemate Redux
description: A remake of the insane demon Stalemate, which was falsely placed at #1 as the verifier insisted upon it being harder than Yatagarasu. The level features early 2.1 decoration, often dark and obscuring, with the 76–100% section being picked through a creator contest.

name: ZAPHKIEL
description: A former top level from early 2.1 notable for its extremely difficult wave parts, an iconic and climactic lava-themed section in the second half, and overall its awkward yet oddly satisfying gameplay. Initially hack-verified by Noctafly.

name: RGB
description: A solo 2.1 extreme demon made by SleyGD themed after the colors red, green, and blue. The level contains many different flashy background effects and a interesting mix of learny and skill-based gameplay. The level is notorious for its very laggy full detail mode and very difficult asymmetrical dual from 76-100.

name: Omicron
description: Unofficial greek letter mega collab hosted by Team Proxima. Has a cool minigame at the end for a coin.

name: Adelucid
description: A gimmicky and fast-paced Extreme Demon utilizing Passable blocks, orb-based gameplay and uniquely ethereal decoration. Its a "true solo"  with the creator having finished the entire song, gameplay, decoration and verification by himself.

name: SOLEIL
description: Well received solo design-art-effect level centered around the sun, moon, and stars. Known to progressively get more difficult, and also have chokepoints in the break part at 44%.

name: lovel
description: Love themed memory & design level with a mostly hot pink colour scheme. The hardest part is the drop with an incredibly difficult mini wave dual. It was made for valentines day, but was a few days late with its release.

name: Tempered Steel
description: Originally an impossible top 1, which was later nerfed to top 50 after being hosted by ItsHybrid. It is the first level in the Metal trilogy. The decoration is themed around steel and heat, with a gray and yellow theme.

name: Killbot
description: A memory level heavily inspired by the 1.9 level “Chaotic Machine.” The level is themed around a virus installing itself on the player's computer, visually obstructing the gameplay through flashes on the screen on top of a lot of fake routes. Also has an infamous UFO chokepoint at the end.

name: vaenstep
description: A typical Renn241 extreme named after the player vaen, who verified and published the level. It is especially skill-based with the slow yet nerve-wracking 72% section being a main highlight. Its decoration uses a diverse colour palette and becomes a colourful mess during the drop despite the level's overall simplicity.

name: Delta Interface
description: The first installment of the Interface series. Has a lengthy predrop, followed by a difficult fast-paced drop, continued with a nerve-racking ending.  One of the first rated extreme demons to use a NONG, albeit the song has since been added to the GD Music Library.

name: The Moon Below
description: The first of two levels in the Beneath - Upward: Perfume EP by Onvil, preceding The Garden Above. It is the harder of the two by far, featuring a cube section with near-invisible timings and a ship section demanding a lot of ship control, separated by a 20 second-long dash orb. The level uses glow objects, cold colours, and is entirely in slow speed to create a tranquil, melancholic atmosphere.

name: Video
description: An 8 minute long level themed around MaxxoRMeN's experiences with internet addiction. It has a randomised minigame section where you have to look out for Mr. Wireless and is accompanied by nearly a minute of difficult fast-paced gameplay in the intro and a high-energy drop with a learny dual 6 minutes in. Extremely well-received for its progression and song representation.

name: find the answer
description: A solo extreme demon made by qalli, which uses a follow trigger setup to make unusual offset dual gameplay, along with other gimmicky gameplay throughout.

name: Artificial Ascent
description: An extremely popular former top 1 megacollab made in 2.0, initially hosted by LmAnubis and finished by Viprin. The level contains a variety of fast-paced gameplay parts made by 18 different creators, spanning almost 2 and a half minutes. It went on to have multiple remakes and sequels, becoming the first installment of the Technology Trilogy.

name: Budding Roses
description: A decently slow-paced megacollab hosted by Zeronium based on his old ship challenge "Vera Lynn." Because of this, the level has many hard ship parts, most notably the ship at 31%-42%, which is the same section of the song used within the original challenge.

name: Edelweiss
description: Ridiculously high CPS and fast-paced mountain themed extreme demon with super learny and middle-carried gameplay and a complex click pattern. Many of the hitboxes are extra lenient, and despite some people experiencing bugs and chokepoints, the level is very well received and highly enjoyed, and many people do it as a hardest. Pronounced ay-dull-vice.

name: TURN THE LIGHTS OFF
description: Zeronium CC entry that uses a Tally Hall song about puberty. The predrop and intermission are shrouded in darkness to match the name (someone turned the lights off). Said parts are also the hardest.

name: Power Grid
description: Fast-paced design extreme with a timings-based first half and a more memory-based second half. Originally was verified by Zeronium before being slightly nerfed and bugfixed by Lucidium.

name: Stereo Extremeness
description: A popular superbuff of Stereo Madness with gameplay made by Vortrox. The level contains very precise timing gameplay, mostly following the layout of Stereo Madness with a difficult robot section in the second half. Was initially made for a youtube video and was later decorated following the layout's initial success.

name: Low Death
description: A superbuffed remake of High Life by Migueword featuring KrmaL's signature unorthodox gameplay with difficult wave and ship sections. There are many easter eggs and ancient memes scattered around the level.

name: I Cry
description: The first level in Tacos' 1.9 GDPS Earth Circles series. Features unique Frutiger Aero decoration and includes a 'choose your path section' in the second half as well as a memory part.

name: Bete Noire
description: The unofficial sequel to the Nine Circles level Fear Me, this extremon is space/electric themed and is very reminiscent of levels like Cosmic Cyclone. Has an endscreen which lasts over 30% of the level.

name: Belloq
description: A desert-themed level based on Pennutoh’s “Spicy Layout #10.” The gameplay emphasizes clicksync, with decoration themed around Egyptian culture.

name: Crystal
description: A solo extreme demon by Zeronium featuring a crystal cave theme. Its gameplay focuses on overall clicksync flowy gameplay with a slight emphasis on ship and wave. Contains a difficult last ship and has a very satisfying dash orb at 53%.

name: Diamond Disco
description: A pure solo extreme one year in the making, notable for its high-CPS clicksync gameplay, an incredibly mesmerising dual and its colour bass-complextro hybrid song. It focuses heavily on song representation, and uses editor particles, bright flashes, screen effects, complementary colours and player movements to create the vibe of a loud EDM disco party.

Well known old level that was abandoned after one of its creators quit the game in 2016, but was revived and verified seemingly out of nowhere in 2020. The gameplay is generally well received, but it's very first half heavy. It's well known for its effecty background, with simple silhouette structures. The level is exactly 2 minutes and 11 seconds long, matching the level's name.

name: Xronier
description: A short, red and blue, pure solo extreme made and verified by now-music artist JinoBeats. Matching the song's chaotic, high-tempo energy its visuals are extremely flashy and its gameplay features many high-CPS bursts and is fast-paced all around. Very well-received amongst victors for getting extremely consistent after some practice, in part thanks to the update it received in 2.2.

name: Night Rider
description: Legendary futuristic cyberpunk-themed XL extreme developed by some of the most distinguished community figures over the course of 5 years. Utilizing an upbeat glitch-hop track, its blend of intricate art and glow-design style decoration creates a unique and immersive metropolis atmosphere. The level consists of mostly learny gameplay across its 3-minute runtime, with the first third of the level being significantly more difficult than the rest.

name: Funnyname Funnygame
description: A three minute long 1.9 effect style solo level that took over two years to create, with parts very reminiscent of Lightwave. The difficulty increases as the level progresses, and the second half features some beautifully janky duals and the infamous Lightwave wave. Has become an insider meme in Aredl for its 1.9 fever dream-like style and low victor count.

name: Polygonal Paradox
description: Black Blizzard inspired timing-based extreme utilizing complementary colors throughout, with a tricky dual in the second half. The gameplay is praised among victors despite being a relatively niche level.

name: Floating Outskirts
description: Technically impressive Pre-platformer platformer level made completely in 2.1. Contains 10 unique sections, each with their own gimmick and environment. Notoriously difficult to control, but satisfying to pull off.

name: Black Flag
description: Click-heavy pirate-themed level with an oddly long predrop and tricky muscle memory-based UFO sections. Known to be incredibly unoptimized and object dense. LDM may be required.

name: Missing Benefits
description: The first and only megacollaboration by Team Caliber, with gimmicky gameplay and dark, greyscale decoration. Known for the last 20%, which is significantly harder than the rest of the level.

name: Bass Cave
description: This level was originally a hard demon, which then got superbuffed and hack-verified. The level later got another update and a legitimate verification by nSwish. Known for its chokepoint heavy gameplay and the goofy looking demon face at 14%.

name: Agony
description: A Congregation-inspired solo extreme which, as the name suggests, is themed around agony with its bright flashes, flesh-like designs and an appropriately-chosen song. Its decoration is made mostly out of the 2.2 pixel objects, and hence it has a surprisingly low object count despite its level of detail and its length.

name: Auroral Ascent
description: Well-received clicksync solo extreme aimed to be a more accessible level in Nexel's catalogue. Consists of a subdued color palette and an intense dual in the second half.

name: Quantum Processing
description: A superbuffed remake of the main level Blast Processing, with gameplay by Riot and Hinds and a short section by Zobros.

name: Dualies
description: 1-minute layout by Gablor which was decoed by multiple creators. Visually inspired from 2.0 levels and Plasma Pulse Finale. Features mirror portal gameplay in an unorthodox manner.

name: VIPER
description: Green-themed glow-design megacollab named after the F-777 song it uses. The level features chokepoint-heavy flow gameplay including various short bursts of difficult wave inputs, with 78% being the most commonly criticized among victors.

name: Black Blizzard
description: Former top 10 solo level by KrmaL. Initially this level was harder and being verified in secret, but after the level was leaked through a hack, KrmaL verified and released a nerfed version. This level got Creo well known within the community. The gameplay is gimmicky and extremely predrop carried.

name: Neurostasis
description: The long standing former top 1 level on the enjoyments list. This level has gimmicky memory gameplay throughout, and most of it is in the ship gamemode with a lot of orbs.

name: Ethereal Artifice
description: Generally well recieved 2.1 megacollab with a red and green color scheme. It's a fast-paced XL level spanning just over two minutes in length.

name: DESOLATE
description: Cube-based extreme themed around a stormy city. Somewhat gradually increases in intensity, but retains a dark and lonely atmosphere throughout.

name: REDEEMER
description: A 7 minute long extreme where giant humanoid spirits are released from their tombs, destroying the earth as they ascend. Widely praised for its atmosphere, storytelling, and song representation. The gameplay is very gimmicky, and features a very hard central section and an asymmetrical ship dual at the end.

name: Astral Divinity
description: One of Knobbelboy's most iconic and controversial solo levels. Formerly named God Eater, the level had to be taken down for copyright infringement, eventually re-releasing with a new name and new decoration. The gameplay is rather skill based, with very difficult ship and wave parts. Was relatively unoptimized before getting an update that cut its object count by nearly half.

name: Glowy
description: A level with gameplay by Sunnett and decoration by Rob Buck. The decoration gradually becomes more object-heavy throughout the level, making it harder to see as the level goes on. The level was meant to mock other glow-heavy levels at the time.

name: Glitched Memories
description: A early 2.1 mega-collab semi-memory level that remixes many clubstep inspired levels. (ie Clubstep, Ice Carbon Diablo X, Tartarus, Red World, 9Step, and Clubstep Nightmares)

name: Static Ignition
description: A solo remake of Electroman Adventures meant to rival Funnyman Adventures. Originally started as mid tier extreme for its time but was buffed in the decoration process. Received a small nerfdate in January of 2023 to nerf some of the highly controversial cube choke points.

name: MISFIRE
description: Pawsome furry themed extweme using an infamously difficult to listen to furry rap song because someone insulted Galaxxyss' music taste. Contains well-recieved flow gameplay with some notable chokepoints like the 52% ship and the "seven inches wave". Used to be harder but received HRT shortly after falling of pointercwate :3

name: Faded Dream
description: Sequel to Endless Dream, created and verified solo, on mobile. Memorable for its atmosphere-focused visuals and climatic drop. Contains learny but very consistent gameplay and a difficult dual at 57%.

name: BuTiTi III
description: Jonathan's nearly-cancelled threequel to his infamous Butiti series. The level is XL, featuring rainbow styled deco and a flashy and laggy pixelated background at the duals. It's also very second half-heavy, with hard and learny duals and a very chokeable ending, it also has interesting and complex coin routes.

name: BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB
description: 2.1 Megacollab hosted by MikeWheelerFan, formally known as Roimousti. It is the sequel to another MikeWheelerFan level called "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA". Infamous for the 88% blue pad, and is generally rather negatively perceived.

name: SHOWDOWN (berrytg)
description: Flow megacollab using xKore - Showdown that is extremely reminiscent of Saul Goodman, even having the infamous upwards wave corridor at the end. As such, it is very learny with many moving objects and has many tough wave sections.

name: Visurient
description: Really old 2.1 level that was made for their friend Visurient. Took a few years to get rated.

name: The Hell Zone
description: Old 2014 hell-themed level by hu dark (Sohn0924) that got redecorated later on by Team N2 and Cyclic, who hack verified it at the time, and got verified legit by Stormfly in 2016, making it the hardest legit completion at the time and being a robbed top 1 after its unrate on the original version. Features obscured gameplay with hard timings, blind clicks and mirror portals. Updated due to enjoyability reasons by Stormfly in 2023.

name: Magnificent Gaps
description: A magnificent remake of Impossible Gaps with a lot of finicky gimmicks and a short 2 player part. The level is fully ship gamemode with simple cute designs and visuals. The lord of chokepoints and raw skill gameplay, johnnwaogus magnificent masterpiece

name: Hyperliminal
description: Vibrant solo extreme making good use of shaders and 2.2 triggers. Consists of bright flashes, unique designs and complex color schemes. With an enjoyment rating of over 90, the 12 playtesters clearly did their job well!

name: The Sulphur Sea
description: A very fast-paced, mini-only solo extreme themed around the Sulphurous Sea from Terraria's Calamity Mod, with a blocky visual style and progressing through the layers of the Abyss, ending off on a randomised bossfight against the Primordial Wyrm. Praised in the community for its well-flowing gameplay and stunning level of detail.

name: Bordon Factory
description: Minimalistic factory themed level that uses gameplay to its fullest potential. Contains multiple gimmicky sections and a randomised bossfight.

name: Hatred
description: 2.0 demon made up of extremely difficult timing gameplay, an infamous ship gravity portal corridor at 70%, and to top it all off, a memory based mini cube section towards the end. Often draws comparisons to Acropolis due to its similar gameplay and theming.

name: Io
description: Warm-toned 1.9 extreme loosely themed around the highly volcanically active moon Io. Hardest level in Latezk's moons-of-Jupiter series. Features a very gnarly dual at 80%.

name: MUSKY MOLD
description: Short and unsettling mold/swamp themed extreme, built by the creator while they were in a mental hospital. Has a unique cube-copter part and some extremely precise timings.

name: Voyager 1
description: A 2.0 styled megacollab one year in the making, encapsulating a variety of decoration styles and gameplay tropes from that era. Throughout its 2 and a half minute runtime it features raw decoration, moving objects and bizarre duals galore, and paired with an old Bossfight song makes for a charming and authentic experience.

name: Gateway
description: Solo extreme with unconventional but intuitive well-received gameplay. Surprisingly Eveteer's first finished level! Notable for its creative effects, good music representation and unique atmosphere.

name: Auditory Breaker
description: Nerfed remake of Sonic Wave made by Lazerblitz and Manix featuring early 2.1 tech style decoration.

name: lodin da fish washer
description: 🐟 A surreal modern style cube/robot timing level with very little spike usage. Features a unique and particularly hard timing (known locally as a 'fish washer') that is repeated multiple times, as well as lots more unusual timing gameplay. 🐟

name: Nostalgia
description: Slow paced timing extreme with a light gold tint made for the KrmaL contest 3.

name: Voltage (Hypno)
description: Contrary to ThePurgatory's "Voltage," Hypno's memory megacollab consists of incredibly unique gameplay and visuals. Specifically, it combines traditional design with extremely unorthodox symmetrical-ish gameplay and structuring, making for a particularly learny and satisfying experience.

name: Necrocide
description: Semi-forgotten Zylenox extreme that went unrated for 4 years. Memorable for its hyper-detailed designs and surprising edginess for the time.

name: Carmine Cascade
description: Scarlet Surge remake with the signature deep red flashy pulses. Features much more memory heavy gameplay than the original, in AAAAAlex's signature style. Extremely well received despite technically being a superbuffed 7 star.

name: SubSonic
description: The 4th official entry of the sonic series, and the hardest one. It was generally considered anticlimactic when it first came out, but nowadays it's gameplay is considered balanced and consistent throughout the entire level. Features an intimidating dual by Jeyzor at the ending.

name: MONSTROSITY
description: A level that was hack-verified, and as such has a lot of chokepoints, such as many parts in the pre-drop and the section around 42%. The gameplay is timing-based and gimmicky, with a repeated ship control section in the last 25%.

name: Khorne
description: Legendary extreme demon with a very rich history. The original version created by Hota1991 had around a million objects, the most out of any level of its time. Because of how laggy the level was for most people, Stilluetto created an nerfed optimized version, cutting the object count in half. The original version was rated twice on accident, once in 2023 and again in 2026 right before the optimized version got rated. The level is split into nine parts, each exploring a different part of hell.

name: Lovestruck
description: Love-themed sequel to Voltage featuring unconventional, heart filled decoration. Built among close friends including popular creators like Pocke, Loltad, & Shmigels. Memorable for its bubbly colors and impossibly memorization-heavy gameplay. Features a unique final ship in which all creators constructed blocky hearts to weave between.

name: Supreme Demon Mix
description: A reimagining of Zobros' "Ultimate Demon Mix", often containing fast-paced gameplay requiring a variety of skillsets. Each part of the level is styled after one of 23 different demons.

name: Kinetic Bypass
description: Kinetic Bypass is a fast, skill-based 2.1 design level by Sminx and verified by Luqualizer. Despite its shorter length, it uses a wide variety of gameplay styles; featuring a slow predrop, wave, robot, a long dual, and flow gameplay.

name: Endless Dream
description: A well-received solo level made entirely and verified on mobile. Known for its simple yet pleasing designs, and for being quite enjoyable especially once you get past the learning process.

name: aether (ZeroSR)
description: Atmospheric design level known for being the first extreme to really go all out with 2.2 features. Contains simplistic monochrome decoration experimenting with gradient triggers and shaders, paired with fast-paced and gimmicky gameplay. Notably has a very scary wave at ~46%.

name: Mujigae
description: Rainbow colored nine circles extreme which can be very hard on the eyes to some without the LDM. It features very difficult chokepoints, most notably the wave gap at 68%. One of two extremes to be featured on the account TheShadowRealm after its creator was exposed.

name: Betrayal of Destiny
description: A lesser-known 2.1 extreme based on WeoWeoTeo's Betrayal of Fate. Features skill based gameplay in the first half before transitioning to more memory based gameplay.

name: Worse Trip
description: Loltad level with very unique deco, paired with very unique (and fun) gameplay.

name: Cheyenne
description: The sequel to the Insane Demon Apache, featuring blinding decoration with an extremely intense song. Started in 2018 and was reworked multiple times.

name: Rate Demon
description: Early 2.1 recent tab themed joke extreme, with unorthodox decoration and many default blocks. The gameplay is entirely cube, robot, and ship, with a long robot part at the drop and an infamous last ship.

name: Dolos
description: 2.1 click sync megacollab, known for its low CPS. Much of the level is a dual, and the ending is difficult and nerve-wracking. Named after the Greek god of deception.

name: Ithacropolis
description: Purple Necropolis remake with a city theme throughout that was made during the transition between 2.0 and 2.1. Just like Necropolis, this level features heavy unbalanced gameplay, like the wave at 31% or the ending corridor, as well as very awkward gameplay and chokepoints. Generally not well recieved and also known for it's text right before the drop "Enter the CITY".

name: milo
description: A Classic styled xSlendy level seemingly inspired by Saul Goodman. Startpos: 120275555

name: RASH
description: Solo extreme themed around diseased and decomposing flesh, with fast paced and generally well received gameplay, and strong music representation. Most notably has a very confusing and unusually structured timing based predrop. The previous description was way too funny so I'm leaving it in: "Loltad level with a very unique and interesting theme, paired with very unique and interesting gameplay."

name: ErebuS (Platnuu)
description: Nerfed and redecorated remake of Erebus made by Platnuu. This level leans into a more biohazard and toxic style theme instead of the generic green theming that the original has. The gameplay is pretty much the same as Erebus except it's easier, but it notably lacks the iconic last click of the original.

name: kuiper belt
description: A 2.2 remake of the wave-only level Kuiper by Quasar and TMNGaming. Made to be as faithful to the original as possible, down to even the balancing. Has a high CPS part at 50% that may be difficult for some.

name: Athanatos
description: Hack-verified level from 2016 which includes very difficult wave chokepoints, including an infamously difficult dual wave at 70%. It is one of the many hell-themed top 1s, surpassing Sakupen Hell when it was placed.

name: Loose Screws
description: Incredibly creative and unpolished extreme with alternative memory gameplay and extremely chaotic decoration, both of which inspired by Toxin Lab III. Features a difficult wave maze and an intimidating predrop. Despite its quirks, the gameplay is very highly regarded among victors!

name: Carnage Mode
description: Early 2.1 timing and nerve control level notable due to numerous chokepoints throughout the level, most noteworthy being the 'pants-shittingly' difficult ending segment by Lemons.

name: Gentlemens Clique (Solo)
description: A 2-player level, a part of the gang trilogy. The level's name is meant to be a British version of Based Gang. Has a key you can collect to turn the bossfight icons into the Bass Cave demon.

name: Wild Rose
description: Vibrant flower-themed design level dedicated to the musician and VTuber Mori Calliope. It features a strong contrast where its slow-paced and tranquil build-up breaks into a flowy and dazzling fast-paced drop lasting until the end.

name: miss you
description: Shmigels solo level featuring intentionally wacky gameplay. Has an infamous last ship, and the asymmetrical dual is featured in BarbarosFinaleFinale with added camera effects.

name: New Record
description: A highly click-sync based megacollab. While the gameplay aligns with the music, its gimmicky nature still requires memorization and practice. The decoration is colorful and energetic, reflecting the fast-paced song. The layout showcase, "highscore w/ clicks", managed to get over 3M views.

name: project girlboss
description: The self-described "most confusing level" in the game, and it's pretty easy to see why. Made by Koko43, this level contains some of the most unconventional (albeit satisfying) gameplay out of any level, with the dual spider section in the final third being particularly unorthodox. The level has a blue and white color palette and a liminal atmosphere that works exceptionally well with the song choice. The cube click at 91% is notoriously difficult.

name: reset your mind
description: Glitchy & hyper-dense solo 1.9 styled level about what the level's name suggests. Memorable for its fun, unconventional memory gameplay and claustrophobic structuring that might appear as object spam at first.

name: Twilight Coexistence
description: Relatively unknown Korean duo level notable for its extremely fast-paced dual gameplay. Contains neo-design adjacent decoration with an inconsistent pink and blue palette.

name: Removed Submission
description: Newgrounds-themed level with a gray and orange color scheme, and uses elements of the site such as bits of text, a big angry emoji, and tankmen to compliment the Newgrounds style. Known for its iconic song which disses BrokenDeck, and the drop parts using unique spider timings.

name: Cryothorn Hell
description: An  ice-themed remaster of Sakupen Hell, containing the same gameplay with some alterations, including the addition of a difficult wave extension and a chokable cube section near the end.

name: Tunnel
description: An extremely large megacollab of 193 people, hosted by Akunakun, where each creator has a 3 block long part. The gameplay is corridor based.

name: Phobos
description: 1.9/2.0 megacollab that was initially hack-verified in a much harder state, but was reverified in an easier form by KrmaL. The level doesn't have a very high enjoyment, and contains a lot of difficulty spikes.

name: WcropoliX
description: Known for being a robbed top 1 and taking nearly 9 years to finally get rated. Infamous for its wave at around halfway through the level.

name: dance (Solo)
description: Solo created and verified 2-player level made for Lia's and Gecko's 2P Creator Contest, using a song from a Persona 4 spin-off game. The gameplay is entirely clicksync and very learny. The drop, from 33%-42%, is by far the hardest part.

name: Infernal Abyss
description: Forgotten sequel to Cataclysm. Hack verified like its predecessor. Infamous for a really difficult UFO at 65%, and a difficult coin at the last ship.

name: Masterpiece
description: An open ended solo level that is intended to run alongside vRidge's other extreme To The Blue Moon.

name: The Old Trail
description: Solo intended XL 2p level by Bram4Real, inspired by his own experience in trail hiking. The level has hard timing gameplay for the predrop and drop, and then turns into a 2p dual for the rest.

name: WOBBLING MACHINE (2P)
description: 2 player extreme where one player has to perform standard gameplay as the other player clicks in a repetitive pattern, matching the rhythm of the 'wobbling' technique in Smash Bros. Melee. Originally hack verified and unrated, but later nerfed and re-verified after which it took over two years to get re-rated.

name: hot rod
description: stcubing's first megacollab, birthed from a Cognition/Oblivion spinoff layout created out of spite for Carcano. It features bright colours and decoration with an upbeat song, and is one of the more accessible levels of this genre.

name: Based Gang (Solo)
description: A 2-player level that takes inspiration from Bang Gang. In order to make it more feasible to do solo, the final 20% can be nerfed in exchange for not getting the coin. Despite this, it's still the hardest part of the level when done solo.

name: MadMansion
description: A remake of the 1.9 level MadHouse, with a grayscale color palette and subtle hints of other hues. Like the original, it is heavily memory-based and uses the same song.

name: S3NT1M3NT
description: A short and fast paced ATOMIC CANNON inspired solo level by AREDL list leader Shyne! Features names of many AREDL members throughout, a horizontal spider orb, and has an infamously hard wave near the end. Has become a large insider meme in AREDL, and additionally took 6 months and 33 opinions to place on NLW...

name: Summer Sky
description: Extremely well-polished XL sky themed extreme memorable for its clean, glass-like block designs and very very well-received clicksync gameplay. Notably uses a special time warp trigger mechanic to keep sync as consistent and quality as possible.

name: Bang Gang (Solo)
description: The first 2-player extreme in Geometry Dash. Was verified by four different people swapping positions mid-completion. The decoration is in DanZmeN's typicial 2019 style. Features learny segments and a bossfight with arrows that are not entirely accurate. The first victor, Grey479 is also the verifier for the level's solo completion, with them being awarded $3,000 AUD for it.

name: OneAttempt
description: A fast-paced level themed around OneShot, containing sections that represent the original areas of the game. Features timings in various gamemodes throughout the level, as well as a choice on how the level ends likewise to the source material and an alternate ending/coin route through using practice mode that changes the decoration noticeably.

name: Coolie Mazie Paloozi
description: Dense & colorful memory "insane demon" created by the feared memory creator Akunakun and verified by the beloved youtuber Tride. Includes 12 large, distinct, and extremely confusing mazes.

name: EnvY
description: DanZmeN level with a goated song, overall is extremely fun, but can feel frustrating due to balancing issues, with waves being the primary difficulty of the level. The ending is terrifying.

name: Poltergeist Reborn
description: 2.1 remake of Andromeda's infamous insane demon. While generally better received than the original, this level remains quite chokepoint heavy. Also features a short extension with a tough memory last wave.

name: Falcon16
description: 2.1 megacollab hosted by LIEB with a prevalent sky theme throughout, infamous for Tob's steampunk themed part and the tight waves at the beginning of the drop. Despite being considered quite first-half heavy and having several blind clicks, it's still received positively by its victors

name: Blade of Justice
description: An extremely high quality 2.0 level by two of the most talented creators at the time. Features multiple iconic parts such as the black hole UFO and asymmetrical dual, and is generally harder at the start and end. Formerly an upcoming top 1 before receiving a large nerfdate making it more accessible and enjoyable. Go up in the ship at 55% to avoid the transition bug!

name: Nautilus
description: Tabgnid's first solo level, a 1.9-style extreme with flow gameplay inspired by Prismatic Haze.

name: Paranoid Android
description: A 5 and a half minute level to the tune of the Radiohead song of the same name. It takes on a very progression-based approach to represent its song - the level spends its first half building up to its climax with fast-paced gameplay and flashy visuals before ending off on a much slower 2 minute-long timing-based ending.

name: Vertigo (notLevo)
description: An early 2.1 extreme demon that took 8 years to be rated. The gameplay has scattered chokepoints, with the middle of the level being much harder than the rest of the level.

name: AUTONOMICA
description: Solo XXL greyscale level themed around exploring a mechanical city, and utilising a vocaloid song to good effect. The gameplay incorporates a lot of moving objects, and has a dual heavy second half

name: Absolute Solver
description: Murder Drones themed level with a nightcore-metal song from the final episode. Involves numerous references from the show and many flashy, tech themed effects. Although incredibly learny, the gameplay is highly praised.

name: THE PRINCE
description: Repetition-based memory extreme using a Madeon song and only cube, robot and ball for its gamemodes. It's reminiscent of the Sunset Sandstorm predrop, with deviations between the same repeated pattern to match the song. The 2nd half is a nerve wracking ball section that is very chokable.

name: Silentium Gradas
description: A Stormfly megacollab remake of Silent clubstep, containing almost identical gameplay, albeit heavily nerfed.

name: EXPLICIT
description: A short, extremely fast-paced level made up of highly compressed difficulty in its total runtime of 41 seconds. Has very tight wave parts that require precise control, as well as generally high CPS gameplay chockfull with timings galore.

name: Infinite Inversion
description: Significantly easier predecessor to Axiom Asterism, featuring electric purple space-themed visuals and fast-paced circles gameplay. Interestingly, the predrop uses only blue pads, orbs & gravity portals.

name: Sakupen Hell
description: Famous for being the level to take the #1 spot away from Bloodbath. Known to be very imbalanced, with the majority of the difficulty coming from the waves. It's also the shortest former top 1 in terms of level length, with the gameplay lasting under 50 seconds.

name: Delicious Dogs
description: A megacollab themed around early 2.1 levels, containing stereotypical decoration and gameplay elements inspired by its reference time period. It took nearly a year for the level to finally get rated.

name: ACHROMATISM
description: 2.2 Prismatic Haze remake that also doubles as the first Turkish solo extreme demon ever!

name: Betrayal of Fate
description: A somewhat lesser known 2.0 extreme with skill based gameplay in the first half, which features a relatively difficult mini ball and dual wave section. The second half introduces memory sections including a cube maze that turns invisible towards the end.

name: Chromatic
description: The official sequel to Prismatic by CatGeo made by a different creator. The gameplay differs with its faster gameplay and difficult ship parts. The decoration has much more variation in it including a complete tone shift at 64%. 2nd Parfait extreme.

name: Advent Aurora
description: The last Extreme Demon uploaded in 2.1; A colorful, glowy, and vaguely aurora-themed level, described by the creator as a "floating world under the moonlight."

name: Revelations
description: A loose mashup of all of vRidges levels. Decorated with a solid design style and utilizing minimal effects. Pair upped with fast paced clicksync and wave burst gameplay. Containing meaningful text scattered around the level.

name: help
description: A-

name: UnveiL
description: Shiver me timbers, be that an XXL pirate themed megacollab! Yahar matey! (full creator list will be added soon)

name: Fusion Z
description: The final installment in the Fusion series. An extremely long and intense level with well rounded but stressful gameplay. Has a very long, complex, and controversial history.

name: Revolution 1993
description: Solo XXL+ extreme to the tune of Revolution 1993 by Jamiroquai. Features many dual sections over its 10 minute runtime. Come on, fight the power!

name: Carcano
description: A popular Cognition-style corridor level built by two Polish creators, with high CPS and timing-based gameplay. Despite receiving a nerfdate in early 2022, community opinions are still quite mixed, which wasn't helped by the slope interaction changes in 2.2.

name: Carbon Fiber
description: Speedy grey & yellow design solo with very high-cps gameplay, clocking in at only 50 seconds long. Contains very difficult wave bursts paired with flowy timings. Notably suffered from a "horrendous case of forced difficulty" before it was re-playtested and verified, allowing it to become pretty well-received now!

name: OPSM1
description: A VARSE level with bright and modern decoration. A good majority of the difficulty comes from the wave sections in the first half, with other small chokepoints scattered throughout the level.

name: Le Midd Mapperoonies
description: A three minute long non stop memory level. Gets gradually harder as the level progresses, with a very hard wave near the end. Received a balance update in late 2024 which both buffed the first half and nerfed the second half, easing the difficulty increase through the level.

name: Astrophobia
description: 1.9gdps nine circles extreme demon collab made by Jakalope, royen, and valentine that focuses on detail and intense nine circles effects reflecting the song. The gameplay and design is generally praised by most people who've played it.

name: Omorfia
description: Effect layout by HHyper, with an iconic bossfight at the end. The gameplay is gimmicky and learny.

name: Game Over
description: A very unorthodox level featuring an abundance of difficult timings in the first section, becoming a high-CPS wave consistency challenge in the second section that tests the player's stamina and spam skill.

name: Project Nexus
description: The official sequel to the list extreme Jigsaw, featuring similarly flowy gameplay and polished tech-themed designs. Originally was gonna be verified by Nexus, but it was passed to LordVaderCraft instead. Generally flew under the radar significantly more than its predecessor.

name: GewErbiX
description: A bright and colourful flow level with a lot of orb focused gameplay.

name: Glacial Torrent
description: Early 2.1 XXL ice-themed megacollab completely created and verified by mobile players. Generally pretty incohesive but charming visually, with part quality varying very significantly throughout. Its gameplay is high-cps and mildly janky, reflecting its time period pretty well.

name: water demon
description: Very complex hexitine level that plays like a puzzle, and includes a difficult mirror section in the middle. The structuring and effects are unique and well-made, but the level is generally poorly received. Contains invisible hitboxes.

name: Untitled
description: Turqoise and cyan colored level with somewhat high cps sync gameplay. The main difficulty comes from the drop. Resembles one of the 'reta' levels to some extent.

name: Inside
description: Hypno's second solo Extreme Demon project, inspired by the rhythm game Sayonara Wild Hearts. It showcases Hypno's signature gameplay style: learny yet intuitive, focused on unique structuring. Noteworthy for its difficult duals, exceptional song representation and simplistic neon designs.

name: moment
description: Highly popular and well received flowy extreme with a simplistic yet pleasing design. Very chokeable, particularly in the wave sections. Features an immediate ship click at the start.

name: maddening
description: geometry dash map that shmigels created using the level editor

name: Ecstasy (SleyGD)
description: Very flashy solo extreme you'll regret opening the editor on due to the sheer amount of triggers. The difficulty features varied gameplay, with a dual lasting from 65 all the way to the end giving it an easy but chokeable ending.

name: gravity
description: Official sequel to Moment, arguably improving on the original. Incorporates a green and pink color scheme while retaining a difficulty very similar to its predecessor. Notably was verified in 2021 and rated in late 2025.

name: Bloodbath
description: One of the most popular extreme demons in the game, and the second level of the Apocalyptic trilogy. This level was known for being the hardest of its time, due to the ship parts being near impossible at the time. Nowadays a pretty tough level, with Michigun's part being arguably the most difficult.

name: Eon
description: A 55-minute level that features mostly 6-7 star gameplay over its extremely long runtime, with decoration built using 2.2 effects and triggers to avoid a high object count. It changes themes and energy a lot throughout to represent the song, and increases in difficulty during the final 12%.

name: OUTPUT SPRING
description: A generally well-received 2.2 Lit Fuse-esque extreme demon themed around the aesthetics of computation, featuring a range of gimmick and clicksync gameplay. The coin requires you to read mock code in order to understand how to obtain it.

name: Idols
description: A megacollaboration by 21 creators serving as a mini-tribute to 1.9, featuring multiple callbacks to older levels. The level is fast-paced with glow-style decoration, and is nearly 4 minutes long.

name: Pale Machine
description: A faithful OMORI-themed megacollab hosted by Blueskii featuring tons of personality and references galore, including hidden cutscenes and a secret epilogue. The player traverses through various environments from the game, meeting friends and foes along the way. Contains spoilers for OMORI.

name: Siniristi
description: Super big early 2.0 megacollab with, some say it was even the biggest one (probably). (Verification video was privated/deleted)

name: Azure Fiesta
description: Prequel to Snowfall Fiesta. The level features a summer-like song with somewhat inconsistent decoration.

name: Motorbreath
description: Colorful skill-based extreme using a Metallica song with very high-cps clicksync gameplay. Contains a difficult predrop and an intimidating cube maze at 84%.

name: Doppler (2P)
description: Splitscreen two player level with a distinct red and blue scheme in reference to the Doppler Effect. Created and verified by At424 & Latezk in two weeks! Memorable for its tech theme and satisfying clicksync. Currently the most enjoyed two player level.

name: Blue Suns Zenith
description: Incredibly creative extreme inspired by Magic The Gathering, using Blue Zenith by xi as its song. Memorable for its difficult sideways wave among other unique gameplay gimmicks. Glory to Phyrexia

name: Crystal Crusher (2P)
description: Simplistic crystal cave themed extreme. Majority of the level features convoluted and long misaligned duals.

name: Down Bass
description: Originally an easier Nine Circles level created in 1.9. Went through a number of different versions and updates throughout 2.0 until it was superbuffed. Seen as rather unpopular due to the buffs made and less-than-desirable appearance. Has some serious chokepoints throughout the wave.

name: PROTOFLICKER
description: An extreme demon collab with a sparkly & glowy effect style throughout. Has a few memory parts and mostly clicksync gameplay scattered around the second half. Received a nerf-date especially for the first wave section.

name: Grind District
description: A 1.9 style memory extreme made by Airz while they were working on Skeletal Shenanigans. Features a very difficult second half.

name: Blueprint
description: Another Waterbound solo that now utilizes more gimmicks like the Beach Ball and the Shwave. It includes a randomized Minesweeper pattern at the end that you have to solve in order to hit the right toggle orb at the end. Also has one of the most evil last clicks in any extreme demon in this range.

name: OUCH
description: Fire themed megacollab with a variety of well known creators, using a buffed Shmigels layout. This level also has randomised memory gimmick where a number at 28% tells you how many times to jump at 33%.

name: angel
description: The creator's "magnum opus" taking 2 years to be finished; a chaotic flashy blue-green level featuring, you guessed it, angels. This level has strict, fast and flowy gameplay all throughout its entirety leading up to a slower, more tranquil ending that serves as a chokepoint for some (notably the last ship). This level was started after a relative of the creator passed away, and the overall theme of the level is overcoming the distortions of life, much like the drop, to "reach the clouds", much like the ending.

name: Barbaros Finale
description: A pirate themed level with very raw gameplay and a bossfight at the end. Has a generally mixed reception due to the nature of its gameplay along with some transparent objects near the end.

name: Dyad
description: A solo XXL extreme where you race your friend to the moon! Created for the Zeronium creator contest, this level features four contrasting sections, repetitive sync gameplay, and a lot of character and personality.

name: i just wish i could
description: Solo intended 2p extreme by Snoozzzing. This level was made as three separate levels, eventually combined into one. The level is about their experience with suicidal ideation and perseverance. The decoration was inspired by sink and 5ta1ker.

name: Prismatic Haze
description: An extremely well known and influential clicksync wave/timing level. Has some very narrow but well synced wave parts, and a slow but very hard ending. Beware of the fish...

name: Sakupen Joy
description: A joyous remake of the famous extreme demon Sakupen Hell with a brighter color palette, a different song, and a boss fight!

name: SLAM
description: Timing extreme in Darwin's classic bright design/effect style. Zoink's easiest level

name: Heavens Door
description: TMco collab themed around the I Wanna Be The Guy needle games. Mostly black and white with small amounts of rainbow coloration and a heaven theme. The gameplay is very learny and increases in intensity throughout the level.

name: A Bizarre Phantasm
description: A classic 2.0 level with challenging, diverse gameplay and icy blue theming. Has an infamous memory part near the end requiring the player to collect 21 keys in a specific order.

name: SUPERCONDUCTOR
description: Extremely high cps solo level by At424. The spider and wave are very high cps, demanding a lot of stamina.

name: Conical Depression
description: Originally made as a joke by KrmaL in 2.0 and rated due to a bet with RobTop over the verification, this level is entirely decorated with 1.0 blocks and is extremely imbalanced. What did you expect?

name: Marathon (weoweoteo)
description: A four and a half minute long, cube only memory level built to be the ultimate endurance test at the time. Features old style decoration and gameplay, and is notable for its insane nerve buildup potential and some harsh chokepoints. The level has 26 distinct sections, one for each mile of the marathon.

name: Triple Six
description: A truly hell-themed memory extreme with artistic yet gory designs. Consists of a flashy 2nd drop with heavy usage of teleportals, and an orbless mini cube maze with ship and wave sections in between.

name: Distortion
description: Colorful maymory memory map created by finley and friends.

name: EKO
description: Faithful Acu spinoff that is almost twice the length of the original. Features many of the same gameplay quirks found in Acu, similar modern deco, and a very hard ending.

name: Stressed Out
description: A Three and a half minute long 1.9 GDPS extreme that pays tribute to many 1.9 levels and Twenty One Pilots. Features lots of tricky duals, UFO sections, and even a nine circles part.

name: Wayback Array
description: Fast, upbeat and fun megacollab started 'way back' in 2019. Took 4 years to complete and another 2 years to get rated.

name: One5Seven
description: Fully solo made level by AREDL List Helper and YouTuber Sdslayer that changes decoration style every couple parts. Gameplay is mostly carried by click-sync but has a few notable chokepoints scattered throughout.

name: Cluttered Confusion
description: Sequel to "Miscellaneous Memory" by the same creator, being much more polished and well-decorated. The gameplay is incredibly learny yet consistent with a pretty hard last dual. Refer to the creator's tutorial video for easier learning.

name: Tron
description: The first Extreme Demon made by the legendary creator FunnyGame, themed around the sci-fi series of the same name. The gameplay is often considered to be of poor quality, and the level contains a long cutscene at the beginning.

name: Callisto
description: 1.9 style extreme memorable for its incredibly satisfying and well-received gameplay. One of the four levels by Latezk named after Jupiter's four largest moons.

name: burn to dust
description: Chaotic design styled learny level with unconventional and super fast paced gameplay. Features very unorthodox structuring and an endscreen where you avoid the text.

name: shattered lens
description: A collab between XDjoa and SoggyDash for the Zeronium CC2! Features stinking greyscale effects and fast paced, dual heavy gameplay throughout.

name: GO bird
description: A long invisible level that follows a group of birds through a forest as the days pass by. The gameplay consist of mostly clicksync timings with some high cps parts present at the drops. Features visual indicators such as trigger orbs to guide the player in some parts.

name: Disentombed
description: Sequel to YakobNugget's previous megacollab Unearthed, containing similarly glowy decoration themed around exploring an underground tomb. Recieved a balance update 2 years after release, and is generally decently aged and well-received.

name: Scattered n Lost
description: Chaotic rainbow memory extreme using enter & exit effects to the fullest. Contains an intimidating cube maze at 70% with distracting visuals and effects throughout the level.

name: CLOWNS
description: Bright and colourful circus themed solo extreme that took 2 years to get rated.

name: Techno Disco
description: Sequel of Techno Flashes that uses the same song. Upgrades the its predecessors decoration by incorporating more complex neon designs and by increasing the energy. The second half features a rainbow color palette and the Flashback Zone™ incase you forgot its a sequel to Techno Flashes.

name: Fever Dream (ElirpscalionPC)
description: Unique design extreme created and verified solo, gradually becoming messier and more dreamlike. Contains high-cps gameplay and difficult straight fly sections.

name: same old
description: Simple & effective design extreme with a distinct RGBY color scheme. Has many repetitive memory sections that pair well with the song, and also has a highly chaotic QuazeryIceCube style maze at the end with hundreds of possible routes.

name: Karma
description: XL Effect layout made by Artu and Marwec. Stays high energy with its intense song and atmosphere paired with its hard dual sections and flow gameplay. Relatively learny and has some chokepoints dotted around the level. (Song ID for Mobile Users that cant use the NONG on the main copy: 127940696)

name: Karasu
description: A collection of rejected Yatagarasu parts that took 6 years to get rated. It is the second level to feature Terron's bird. The level heavily relies on chokepoints and nerves.

name: INNARDS
description: Grayscale with red level, with a lot of blood details. This was initially a nearly-impossible top 1, before being extremely nerfed. While everything's mostly balanced, the wave sections can be quite the difficulty spikes.

name: Antonymph
description: An upbeat and colourful extreme set to ANTONYMPH by VyletPony

name: 6LACKLIGHT
description: *Epilepsy Warning*

name: WaveBreaker
description: Old collab level with a lot of familiar faces such as Dorami, Danzmen, and our most popular, Chlorines. Overall its a pretty fun, fast paced level, with a hard predrop.

name: ETERNAL
description: Solo layout-styled flow level by with a deep blue and black color scheme. Contains difficult duals and timings, and keeps a constant fast pace throughout. Is generally well received.

name: Treatment Facility
description: 1.9 styled design level inspired by Toxic Sewers, themed around escaping an underground wastewater facility. Includes lots of subtle effects and movements to build immersion. References the infamous Rupture wave at 40%.

name: Lovers Sadness
description: Minimalist solo extreme telling an abstract story about grief. Features creative dual-based gameplay, representing two separate individuals. Garnered controversy for being rated despite its simplicity, though it is extremely well received among victors.

name: super kontik
description: Russian duo level featuring a flashy rainbow color scheme and fast-paced clicksync gameplay. Memorably contains a randomized robot section where you have to collect Super Kontik cookies. "best sandwich cookie you have probably ever seen in your life."

name: Empyrean
description: Kivvvi's magnum opus; a well-enjoyed solo extreme 7 months in the making featuring highly detailed designs and artwork with fast-paced clicksync-based flow gameplay. Much of the level's difficulty comes from the first section of the drop, especially in the short wave segments, creating a bit of a stress test for the latter half of the level.

name: Penultimate Phase
description: Quirky 2.1 level that doesn’t actually bear any resemblance to The Ultimate Phase other than using a later part of the same song. Contains a fair share of unique dual parts and a long Going Up cutscene at 32%.

name: GrizzlyWare
description: Code themed solo extreme with a predominantly green and red colour scheme, inspired by Toxic Sewers, Rupture, and Controlled Chaos. The drop is mostly comprised of mirrored gameplay.

name: FTW
description: A 2.0 styled extreme demon with distinct wave sections, tricky ship parts, and diverse click patterns that resembles old styled gameplay, along with appealing yet somewhat simplistic decoration elements.

name: BEELINE (2P)
description: Very vibrant splitscreen 2 player level with the parts being references to various games. Includes some tricky and fast-paced gameplay, with the beginning being the hardest one.

name: Zenith (Lan IIVX)
description: Solo XXL extreme with a variety of styles, themed around finding forgiveness for mistakes.

name: All In
description: Flowy clicksync extreme themed around gambling, featuring a consistent red and black color scheme with many references to cards and casinos.

name: PISTON
description: Solo extreme inspired by the piston from Minecraft! The pistons move the blocks in the level around, making for some interesting moving object heavy gameplay.

name: laranja azul rosa
description: Translating to “Orange Blue Pink,” this level uses a strict 3-color palette. The gameplay is unorthodox, with learny duals and memory-based gimmicks. The community seems determined to keep the level at exactly 0 likes on the servers for reasons unknown.

name: plunq
description: Heavily Sink by Awedsy inspired level that uses a Project Sekai song. Formerly one of the worst received levels on the entirety of the EDEL, until it received a heavy nerfdate that improved the reception of the level by a lot.

name: gardening map
description: Silly 2.1 memory collab with unorthodox gameplay and structuring and tons of tiny jokes and references. Beware the creature at 21%.

name: wires
description: Atmospheric & monochromatic robot-only extreme with a gloomy song by The Neighborhood. Takes subtle inspiration from Zylenox, featuring a fast-paced climax.

name: Sigma Interface
description: Has a very chill atmosphere and gameplay that is mostly timings, wave, and ship. Was supposed to have an extension but was released early.

name: aftermath
description: The third and final level of the Apocalyptic trilogy, featuring very similar gameplay to Cataclysm, but harder.

name: I Wanted To Sleep
description: A pure solo extreme heavily inspired by Eon clocking in at 20 minutes long. Many concepts from Eon are present here, and it takes advantage of its shorter length to experiment more with structures, designs and song representation without inflating its object count. Its gameplay is notable for 3 distinct fast-paced segments starting at 17.2%, 45.8% and 79%, separated by slower, easier gameplay.

name: We Are Not The Same (2P)
description: 2-player duo collab where player 2's part is extreme and player 1's is significantly easier to the point of non-demon gameplay, hence the name. Consists of themeless and pretty low-key visuals, including a review about the mario movie at end. I don't think we're alike at all Mr. White...

name: love0
description: Unconventional breakup themed design level with unorthodox orb combinations and psychedelic visuals. Unfortunately the platformer checkpoint at 88% does not let you respawn...

name: Perfect in Place
description: Solo intended 2p level, created for someseal's solo 2p creator contest. The gameplay is high cps, frequently switching between 2p and 1p sections. It's grayscale and effect heavy decoration is based off of both an older unrated level by Jemma, and the Undertale "Disbelief" animation.

name: Cat Planet
description: A joke cat themed remake of both Aquamarine and Planet Circles. Features a long and easy predrop followed by an extremely hard wave. Has an SC66P inspired part and the PG Clubstep cat.

name: Godspeed
description: A fast paced megacollab co-hosted by MrFreckles and Rynoxious that has been in development since 2021!

name: PanaSonic
description: Early 2.1 megacollab with a lot of varying decoration styles and incredibly poorly received gameplay. Became the first Extreme Demon moved to TheShadowRealm after the host/verifier was exposed for incredibly inappropriate acts.

name: F3XMAXXING
description: A fast-paced, flashy, timing-oriented level which utilizes black, white and red checker designs inspired by the skin "Devesto" from the Roblox game Die of Death. It is also the first rated solo extreme made by a Lithuanian.

name: Rift
description: 1.6 Extreme demon megacollab that features vibrant colours, several tricky ship sections and a difficult predrop. The gameplay still manages to feel modern and polished despite its limitations. Generally considered to be the most well received 1.6 extreme.

name: Niflheim
description: An old 2.0 pseudo-memory level featuring unique designs and moving objects, very hard ball timings, and lots of text portals. LDM ball cube ball big cube ball next...

name: SINK (OwOPink)
description: A solo extreme demon created by OwOPink. Features an underwater theme which incorporates glow style decoration and some experimental gimmicky gameplay inspired by RUST and Gaggatrondra. Harbours a total of 169 fish throughout the level including 5 in the endscreen representing the first 5 victors of the level. Don't drown.

name: KINGSLAYER
description: We are experiencing technical difficulties displaying this level's video, due to Sony Music Entertainment blocking it. Please replace or mute the song in your record if you plan on beating this level, as we can't look at your record if we can't see the video.

name: Maybe Possibly Thing
description: Memory level known for being goofy and having a funny bossfight. Is skewed towards mainly ship gameplay.

name: Manic Machine
description: Generally well-received timing and memory-based extreme demon with a green and red corrupted technological decoration that was made in 2.1. It was inspired by the 1.9 insane demon Chaotic Machine and is similar to Killbot although it contains less flashes. Has a very difficult ending.

name: FURY TECH
description: FRANK

name: Momentary Affection
description: The sequel to Lost Love that will really test your ability to memorize a path and ability to learn duals.

name: Libertas
description: Energetic Korean collab with decoration combining design elements of 1.9, 2.0, and early 2.1. It received a significant nerfdate awhile after its release but still maintained its quirky fast-paced gameplay. Spent 2.5 years in development hell, beginning in ~2017.

name: Audio Extraction
description: Originally created in 2.0 and got a bugfix and decoration update in 2.1. It had one of the earliest uses of the dual wave gimmick where both waves share the same gravity.

name: BROWNOIX
description: Well-received dual-based megacollab featuring a consistent green and yellow palette and great gameplay. Memorable for its flashy effects and learny duals

name: Huellas En La Nieve
description: A peaceful but extremely hard to learn memory level. Features a part where you must break every block in order to progress which does not work in practice mode. Also features a terrifying vertical memory wave at the end.

name: Redemption Arc
description: Wulzy’s first created extreme taking a twenty-seven video long playlist and 678 days from start to finish. Features several parts with different effects and skillsets. Overall very well received.

name: No Ember
description: A collage style fast paced level that switches style with each part. The difficulty is ending carried, and the level features many bursts of high cps gameplay.

name: BRAINROT
description: Design style memory level using control: mind, and is somewhat reminiscent of Sleepless by ChaSe gameplay wise. Features some split path gameplay and a cube maze around the halfway point. Sadly has nothing to do with actual brainrot so do not expect to find Triple T or 67 kid.

name: Synergy
description: XL design megacollab between several well established creators. Has several fakes/learny parts and chokepoints scattered about, most notably a ridiculously high-cps spider part at 29%. Decoration varies in quality due to it being made over the course of 4 years.

name: SorryForPartyRocking
description: A rainbow themed extreme demon that uses a cornandbeans and Sorry For Party Rocking mashup. Features plenty of fast paced gameplay broken up with slower memory & timing parts.

name: Halberd
description: Visually amazing level with the art style of Kirby Super Star. It has a giant maze with multiple routes, a few chokepoints and a very difficult part at 33% where you need to click in-sync to the music.

name: Warios Gold MinE
description: Themed off of the Mario Kart Wii track by the same name, this gold mine themed level has many references to its source material, and is also generally very well received.

name: Glide
description: A unique extreme demon featuring many double-clicks. The gameplay is learny and somewhat inconsistent but satisfying, reflected by its mixed reception. Most of the difficulty is condensed into the cubes at the beginning and 71%, which include fixed hitboxes.

name: SLAY MOMENT
description: ItsMeGeoGD's latest modern extreme! Features sync gameplay and some very fabulous wave gaps.

name: Heartbeat (KrmaL)
description: An iconic 2.0 extreme featuring blood-red theming and unconventional gameplay, with infamous sections such as the 47% wave spam and the ending cube.

name: Endurance
description: A faithful remake of Marathon, rebalanced to remove chokepoints and emphasize nerve buildup and consistency. The decoration gets gradually more complex as the level progresses

name: Weald
description: Peaceful woodland themed solo extreme featuring slow paced gameplay and an asymmetrical dual.

name: me when machine gang (2P)
description: A 2-player memory level by akunakun that was made in one sitting, with mostly path-based memory other than the splitscreen dual.

name: Just A Bunch Of Idea
description: Short extreme consisting of various different "ideas" in terms of decoration ranging from a ship including album covers to a flower-themed robot, and a handful of camera effects are also present. It also contains a very difficult last wave.

name: Avalanche (Filqh)
description: BLBL inspired extreme demon originally made 4 years ago, now fully updated and reverified by DaMeister.

name: Warning
description: Skill-based clicksync design solo utilizing lots of cool complementary colors and satisfying fast-paced timings. Leans towards being ship/wave carried, but it has some difficult cube timings as well. Unfortunately had to be reverified after the previous verifier was exposed.

name: Sides Of My Mind (2P)
description: A 2-player level that splits apart and then recombines together in the end. Visuals contain a lot of contrasting effects and feature rainbow and monochrome palette.

name: Out of Chaos
description: An extreme that's alike to Nhelv, even down to the song. The theming is of a struggle with mental health which is represented through its well-created, surreal effects in the decoration and its predominently black, white and red coloring which becomes very colorful nearing the end. Also features well-received, unorthodox gameplay with several dual sections, especially 83% - 86% due to the horizontally uneven ship gameplay.

name: VIRTUE
description: VARSE's first public level renowned for it's atmospheric decoration and for the style switch at 44%. Contains a very creative wave part at 80%, with somewhat learny clicksync gameplay throughout.

name: Myocardia
description: A modern extreme themed around biomechanics and the circulatory system. It features artwork in both the background and the foreground, fusing the two themes. Mainly features D-block wave gameplay and vertical dash orbs throughout the level, and explores unconventional gameplay ideas for its runtime with the intention of encapsulating the energy of the song.

name: The Ultimate Return
description: Sequel to vit12's level ''The Ultimate Demon''. The decoration and gameplay take inspiration from several popular extreme demons, similar to The Ultimate Demon. It's also not very well recieved, due to containing some awkward and blind transitions, as well as very inconsistent gameplay. As the result of containing a lot of wave demons, this gamemode is the most used.

name: Wacky McWhackface v2
description: Buffed Acu remake featuring a very similar click pattern and glow deco. Has an AI generated name.

name: Ergonomic Chair
description: A chair designed for efficiency and comfort. (Purple and yellow extreme mainly featuring ship and wave gameplay, but also features a swing dual and a multi-creator triple trial at the end.)

name: Destinies
description: A very long solo art level inspired by many other XL art levels such as Emerald Realm and Well Rested. The gameplay gets progressively faster paced and intense towards the end, and it features a lot of spider/spider orb gameplay. One of the most enjoyed extremes.

name: HyperHyperHyperHyper
description: Twan's first solo!!!

name: Tenkai (2P)
description: Hideki's two player level that went unrated for years; features solo gameplay for the first 40%, and a dual for the rest of the level.

name: Spacious Senses
description: Memory extreme with QuazeryIceCube's signature freeform gameplay with many possible routes, and simple but effective decoration. The first half contains most of the difficulty, and a handful of timing chokepoints.

name: Welcome To GD News
description: An easy extreme demon megacollab hosted by Vortrox to celebrate the success of his “GD news” video series on Youtube. It contains unique well-rounded flow gameplay.

name: 1330X
description: A fast-paced extreme collab filled with brutal gameplay complemented with glow-style decoration. Notoriously has a very chokable last wave and ship.

name: Hopping Over Puddles
description: Ruins themed level with calm deco and gameplay, mainly based in slow timings of cube and robot, it has surprisingly hard parts for its placement due to the duration of the level.

name: Pumped Up Kicks
description: An early 2.1 XXL megacollab hosted by Quiken, infamous for having unbalanced gameplay and the 47% orange orb timing.

name: recollection
description: High energy memory megacollab verified by LordVadercraft with flashy effects and dense, rainbow filled decoration. Has a notoriously difficult last click.

name: Recrystallize
description: A four minute long 1.9GDPS megacollab featuring parts made by GrenadeofTacos' family members. Has mostly fast paced, learny and well rounded gameplay. Also has a Toyota

name: Sleepwalking
description: Waterbound's second extreme demon, this time created in a minimal but atmospheric design in 24 hours. Uses only the cube gamemode once again.

name: CRUEL
description: Dark red castle themed Cherryteam collab, verified and published by Denni

name: Thoughtless Space
description: Remake of Thinking Space II, rated as a low end extreme demon. It was created as a solo level by KZLR at the request of his friend Neeple, who wanted to verify an extreme demon level. Features fast paced cube and ship gameplay with an infamously difficult last jump.

name: A2Marbl
description: An easier but similarly fast paced clicksync sequel to ATMarbl. Features a hard last spider and Temp's insane wave part.

name: 4Elements
description: A faithful remake of Eiken's famous 1.9 insane demon The Four Elements. Took over a year to create, and each part features detailed and well themed decoration using 1.9 limitations. The gameplay is similar to the original but much harder.

name: Yeo Baek
